body:
**Fiquzic** is the emerging artist at the centre of this showcase, presented by [@get2know.tags](https://www.instagram.com/get2know.tags/) and shared by B-POP Tags on 20 October 2026. The caption calls [@fiquzic](https://www.instagram.com/fiquzic/) "an emerging star drafted on our Radar" and asks followers to "keep this between us until the algorithm catches up on him."

## An emerging artist showcase, not a press release

The post doesn't come with a biography, a release list or tour dates, and we won't make any up. What it offers is a signal: this is someone we think is worth hearing early. The cover puts the B-POP Tags logo beside the "Discover Fresh" and Get2Know Tags marks, over an illustrated portrait framed by a checkerboard band, with a line about "tomorrow's headliners" running across the top.

## Following Fiquzic from the start

The showcase follows our [Early Access post on Fiquzic](post:fiquzic-early-access) from the day before, which promised an exclusive interview on Get2Know Tags. Together the two posts show how B-POP approaches [music in Bangladesh](topic:music): spotting artists before the wider feeds do. If you like finding names early, try our pieces on [Mass $cott](post:mass-scott-modern-bangla-trap) and [Rodoshi's "Arektu"](post:rodoshi-arektu-single).

The caption signs off with a question, "WHO'S NEXT???", so tell us who belongs on the radar. More discoveries are on the [B-POP Tags home page](home:).

[See the original post on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DeuaDVaN7NT/)
